cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
DATA_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
STATE_FILE="$DATA_DIR/state.json"
LOG_FILE="$DATA_DIR/worker.log"

i=0
while :; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  ts=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  printf '{"tick":%s,"timestamp":"%s"}\n' "$i" "$ts" > "$STATE_FILE.tmp"
  mv "$STATE_FILE.tmp" "$STATE_FILE"
  echo "$ts tick=$i" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh

cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
ReadOnlyPaths=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
StateDirectory=inventory
StateDirectoryMode=0750
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
RestrictRealtime=true
RestrictNamespaces=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
RemoveIPC=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM
UMask=0027

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
